notes.title: POPUCOM - Patch Notes 7/15 (V1.0.6)
notes.notes:
Heya adventurers, 


Thank you so much for your continued interest and support.

To improve your game experience, we've just released a new update for POPUCOM. Please check the patch notes below.

*Older versions no longer support online play. Be sure to update your game!



▼New Feature: "Hardcore Adventurer" Mode

// With faster combat pace and increased difficulty, this mode offers more intense challenges! See if you can clear every battle without using continues!

- When enabled, heart bubbles dropped in combat will not pop when shot.

- Once combat ends, heart bubbles will automatically pop, and players can collect the released hearts.

- This mode can only be toggled through the Settings menu either from the Pancake or the Main Menu.



▼Optimized Controls: [Rollo the Bomb] & [Captain Kitty]

- Added quick summon for [Rollo the Bomb]. The default control is pressing the Left Stick (L3/LSB) on controllers, or the Alt key on keyboard. This control can be remapped in Settings.

- Added a [Captain Kitty sensitivity] option for keyboard & mouse mode in Settings. This allows players to adjust mouse sensitivity.

- Added new keyboard & mouse controls. Players can now press the Q and E keys to make Captain Kitty interact with the [Just Spin me] switches.



▼Stages & Enemies

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Windmill Meadow] stage, Polymu might not be considered defeated when pushed off the platform.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Ocean Rig] stage, Stubborn Plank might unexpectedly disappear, making it impossible to continue playing.

- Fixed an issue where, in a certain part of the [Glacier Weather Station] stage, Prismatetras would not reset when thrown off a platform.

- Fixed an issue where, in a certain part of the [Glacier Weather Station] stage, the Cannon of Friendship would disappear during online co-op, making it impossible to continue playing.

- Fixed a display issue with the Prismatetra's trajectory that could occur in the [Glacier Weather Station] stage.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Solar Power Plant] stage, the bell for summoning the Goodiebot Balloon Bus might not be correctly displayed in the cockpit view.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Glacier Weather Station] stage, Prismatetras might occasionally not reset as expected.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Solar Power Plant] stage, the battle might be triggered early before entering the Ninjamu area.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Sunset Drilling Base] stage, players might not be able to throw Prismatetras to the opposite platforms under certain conditions.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Desert Arsenal] stage, certain actions might get the Kind Bear stuck at a platform, making it impossible to continue playing.

- Fixed an issue where, in certain parts of the [Base of Evil Science] stage, the Color Sensor Switches failed to respond to the touch of players of the matching colors.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Base of Evil Science] stage, if the Stubborn Plank was placed vertically, the Color Sensor Platforms might remain active when players were not around the Color Sensor Switches.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Base of Evil Science] stage, high network lag might cause the Color Sensor Switches not to respond to the touch of players of the matching colors that stand on the Barrier Bots.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Arcade Monster] stage, adventurers might not be able to recover health when caught by Binka 2600's hands.

- Fixed an issue where, in party mode stage [Use Prismatetra to Navigate Through~], players could get Prismatetras to clip through metal mesh in edge-case scenarios.

- Fixed an issue where, in the third section of the [Check Out the Color Before You Jump!] stage, players might occasionally die when moving through Cloud Pads of their colors.

- Fixed an issue where, in party mode stage [Shield Up and Build a Bridge!], players might respawn at abnormal positions, making it impossible to continue playing.

- Fixed an issue where, in the [Battle for Meowtopia] mini-game, glitched enemies and projectiles might appear during combat, affecting subsequent gameplay.



▼Art & Visuals

- Optimized the cameras and animations for certain cutscenes of the [Power Nexus] stage.

- Fixed a shoe model clipping issue in the dialogue before the unlocking of the arcade room.

- Fixed an online mode issue that, under certain conditions, players could equip additional attire while wearing the [Academy Style] outfit.

- Fixed several UI display issues.



▼System

- Optimized the emote wheel controller controls with X- and Y-axis inversion enabled.

- Fixed an issue where one heart might be missing from either adventurer's health bar after both adventurers died and respawned in Story Mode.

- Fixed an issue where remapping the [Switch color] key in Settings might incorrectly trigger a conflict warning.

- Fixed an issue where players using controllers might not be able to select outfits after entering the shop and dismissing all pop-up prompts.

- Fixed an issue where pressing the D key on the stage selection screen of the [Volley-Boink] mini-game could cause the game to freeze.

- Fixed an issue where, in online play mode, the text for Player 2 Assist options was not correctly displayed in some languages.



▼Others

- Fixed the issue that the game would not launch properly on certain devices.

- Fixed an issue where, after completing mini-games in the arcade room, the Main Menu music might unexpectedly start playing and background music might be missing in Party Mode stages.

- Fixed an issue where, when playing Story Mode tutorials online and Player 2 had unlocked a sub weapon, Player 2's inputs could trigger the sub weapon switching sound effect even when the weapon did not appear in the UI.



—————————————————— 

Have feedback or suggestions? We'd love to hear from you. Reach us via the official website or email!  

- E-mail: popucom_cs@gryphline.com 

- Customer Service Center: Visit the official POPUCOM website, scroll to the bottom, and click [Contact Us] 



Looking for teammates or a place to chat about the game? Join our [Official Discord]: https://discord.gg/popucom

Heya adventurers, 

Thank you so much for your continued interest and support.

*Older versions no longer support online play. Be sure to update your game!



▼Stages & Enemies

- Fixed an issue where players could reach unintended areas using Rollo the Bomb under certain conditions in the [Polar Icebreaker] stage.

- Fixed a Buddybot respawn issue that halted gameplay after it fell from the platform in the [Startower Park] stage.

- Fixed an issue where landing indicators failed to appear after Piggy Step was grabbed by Captain Kitty in the [Startower Park] stage.

- Fixed a respawn point issue with Prismatetra and players that halted gameplay under certain conditions in the [Glacier Weather Station] stage.

- Fixed a Prismatetra reset issue that occurred after Player 1's defeat under certain conditions in the [Glacier Weather Station] stage.

- Fixed a camera freeze issue that halted gameplay after Bunnybot triggered its sensors under certain conditions in the [Machinery Plant] stage.

- Fixed a sticker collection issue caused by Stubborn Plank not being placeable under certain conditions in the [Base of Evil Science] stage.

- Fixed an issue where Legmu-α's attack mode would act unexpectedly under certain conditions in the [Base of Evil Science] stage.

- Fixed an issue where landing indicators failed to appear after Stubborn Plank was grabbed by Captain Kitty under certain conditions in the [Base of Evil Science] stage.

- Fixed an interactable respawn issue that halted gameplay under certain conditions in the [Aerospace Rift] stage.

- Fixed an issue where enemy attacks would persist after defeating both players under certain conditions in the [Pomu Dragon] stage.

- Fixed an issue where players could collide at respawn points under certain conditions in the [Use Prismatetra to Navigate Through~] stage in Party Mode.

- Fixed several issues where Goodiebot Balloon Bus failed to pick up players, threw them off, and caused camera glitches under certain conditions.



▼Art & Visuals

- Improved the visual design around the ears for the [Amazing Antenna] hairstyle.

- Fixed incorrect depth of field in stage clear animations that occurred under certain conditions.

- Fixed an issue with the door opening animation triggered by bomb switches in local split-screen mode in the [Old Energy Center] stage.

- Fixed an issue with the door opening animation in the [Old Energy Center] stage in local play.

- Fixed an issue with the Mysterious Dice animation in the [Tropical Isle] stage.

- Fixed an issue where coins turn black under certain conditions in the [Power Nexus] stage.

- Fixed an issue with the Sugarmu animation under certain conditions in the [Sunset Drilling Base] stage.

- Fixed an issue where character model flickered under certain conditions when players completed a stage and touched the colored star in Party Mode.

- Fixed inconsistent color display on the [Barrier Clown] weapon skin for Player 1 and Player 2.

- Fixed an issue where the weapon model remained on the platform after Player 1 picked it up under certain conditions.



▼System

- Improved the unlock conditions for Goodiebot-related achievements. Players who have collected all Goodiebots will automatically unlock the [Baddie Pal] and [Hero or Bandit] achievements. The system will auto-check and unlock them upon entering the Pancake after the update.

- Fixed an issue where the title screen would fail to display menu UI under certain conditions.

- Fixed an issue that caused players to get stuck on the server connection screen when creating an online room after a network disconnect, even if the connection was restored.

- Fixed an issue where low controller stick sensitivity could prevent proper emote wheel selection.

- Fixed an issue where multiple UI layers would stack incorrectly in [Battle for Meowtopia] under certain conditions.

- Fixed an issue where Player 2's missile launcher interactions wouldn't trigger popups in online co-op.

- Fixed inconsistent HP display for both players under certain conditions in online co-op.

- Fixed a display issue with Player 2's button UI after Player 1 paused the game in online play of [Volley-Boink].

- Fixed an issue preventing real-time updates when switching [friendly fire damage] on/off during gameplay in Party Mode.



▼Others

- Improved the cutscene performance before certain boss fights.

- Improved save data logic to prevent save file corruption under certain conditions.

- Fixed an issue where the User Agreement could not be confirmed using controllers.

notes.title: POPUCOM Release Time Confirmed! Pre-Orders Now Open!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601111/97d472ea9dbde463b3418973a06f7822ea83d19d.png
The wait is finally over, adventurers!

Pop yourself into an adventure! Become the rainbow!
POPUCOM, the 3D co-op platformer, now officially has a release date. Pre-orders are now available on PC platform!

 Pre-orders Open: May 22, 2025, 20:00 (PDT)
 Official Release: June 1, 2025, 20:00 (PDT)


Release FAQ
We've also put together an FAQ to answer some of your questions about the pre-order and release. Feel free to check it out and share it with your friends!

Q: What languages are supported in the game?
A: The game supports 11 languages:
English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish (Spain), German, French, Russian, Portuguese (Brazil), and Italian.
You can switch languages in the [Settings] menu on the main screen.

Q: What's included in the launch version?
A: The official launch version of POPUCOM comes with the full game content, including:
[Story Mode] Main storyline stages for 2-player co-op
[Party Mode] More challenging stages for 3-4 player multiplayer. Recommended for players with Story Mode experience

Q: Does this game support online multiplayer?
A: PC players can play online multiplayer through [Online Mode]. To cross-play between different PC storefronts, use a [Room ID] to create or join a multiplayer room.

Q: Is there a launch bonus? How do I get it?
A: Yes! There's a limited-time launch bonus. Just log into the game during the event period to unlock it for free. The bonus includes 2 sets of outfits (6 pieces total):
[Hairstyle]: Soothing Breeze, Clean Look
[Attire]: Cozy Afternoon, Leisurely Holiday
[Footwear]: Morning Breeze, Eco-Warrior
Event Time: Official launch – June 15, 2025, 19:59 (PDT)

Q: How do I contact the customer support if I run into an issue?
A: You can contact us in 2 ways:
Email: popucom_cs@gryphline.com
Customer Service Center: Visit the official POPUCOM website, scroll to the bottom of the page, and click [Contact Us].



Looking for teammates or a place to chat about the game? Don't forget to join our [Official Discord]!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44601111/bab878cd2f69f6835326212782fd6e09ba15b6f8.png

notes.title: Patch Note 10.17
notes.notes:
Dear adventurers! The Popucom demo has been updated. Please update the game and enjoy the new features.

The previous version may prevent you from playing the online mode. Please promptly update the latest version to avoid issues with online mode access.

[olist]
 Fixed some issues that prevented players from adequately experiencing the online mode.
 Fixed an issue in online mode where the 2P screen may not display Shiny Ultramu in the Desert Mineral Field.
 Fixed an issue in the Desert Mineral Field, where the respawn location of the  Prismatetra could be incorrect, causing the stage not to progress as intended.
 Fixed some crashes caused by compatibility issues.
[/olist]
